cases.objective: Confirm the configured flat monthly rate.
Verify flat monthly interest on original principal.
cases.remarks: Formula: monthly = principal x rate/100; total interest = monthly x months; payable = principal + total interest.

cases.objective: Verify the synthetic loan A terms.
Confirm a zero principal does not create interest.
Confirm a negative principal cannot produce a negative payable.
cases.remarks: The implementation clamps principal with max(0, amount) instead of throwing.

cases.objective: Confirm a negative rate does not reduce principal.
cases.remarks: Negative rates are clamped to zero.

cases.objective: Confirm a zero-month term is not charged as a one-month loan.
cases.expected: Invalid duration is rejected or does not create one month of interest.
cases.remarks: max(1, term) coerces zero months to one month and charges interest of 500.00.

cases.objective: Confirm a negative term is not silently converted into a chargeable month.
cases.expected: Invalid duration does not produce a one-month charge.
cases.remarks: Same coercion as UT-007.

cases.objective: Verify half-up rounding to centavos after the unrounded calculation.
cases.remarks: Each returned field is rounded separately. Rounded monthly interest times months is 15.06, while total interest remains 15.05.

cases.objective: Verify the upper configured loan amount.
Parse a numeric term from a label.
A term without digits returns zero so callers can treat it as missing.
Document how a numeric zero term is parsed.
cases.expected: The parser returns 1 because numeric input uses max(1, value).
cases.remarks: This matches the coercion observed in UT-007.

cases.objective: Confirm payment counts for each frequency.

cases.test_data: live key not loaded into this process

cases.actual: Only local handler calls were executed.

findings.description: A zero or negative loan term is coerced to one month, so the calculator charges one month of interest instead of rejecting the duration.
findings.reproduction: Call calculateLoanInterestBreakdown(10000, 5, 0). Observed total interest 500.00 and total payable 10500.00.
findings.recommendation: Reject a term less than 1 at the calculator and at the application form before interest is stored.
findings.retest: Not retested. Application code was not changed.
